mapper.sql: SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.customer_id, so.customer_name, so.product_name, so.quantity, so.unit, so.amount, so.status, CASE so.status WHEN 0 THEN '待处理' WHEN 1 THEN '已确认' WHEN 2 THEN '已发货' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_name, so.delivery_time, so.shipping_time, so.operator_name, so.remark, so.create_time, so.update_time FROM sale_order so WHERE 1=1
